title: Evidence Based Management of Acute Biliary Pancreatitis
brief_summary: This study aims to assess the outcome of standardized evidence-based care to all patients with acute biliary pancreatitis treated at surgery department, Zagazig University hospitals during the period from may, 2017 to may 2019.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* all cases with acute biliary pancreatitis

Exclusion Criteria:

* all cases with non biliary pancreatitis
study_population: All cases with acute biliary pancreatitis admitted to surgery department in the study period were included in the study
